questions.question: If the time in the mirror image of a 12-hour clock is 3:55, what is the actual time?
questions.solution:
According to the given information,

The reflection effect can be found by subtracting the given time from 12:00, since **in a mirror image, every hour has an opposite position. **Start with the given time, 3:55.

Formula: 11 : 60 - Given Time

Subtract 3:55 from 12:00 to determine the actual time: First, subtract the minutes: **[{60 minutes (in 1 hour)} - 55 {minutes} = 5 minutes}] **

Since we borrowed 1 hour to do the minute subtraction, we have to subtract 1 hour from 12 hours: **[11 {hours} - 3 {hours} = 8 hours}]**

So, the actual time is 8:05. 

Hence, the correct answer is **"****8 : 05"**.

similarly,

So,

Hence, the correct answer is "**241"**.

questions.question: If 21 May 2009 is Thursday, then what will be the day of the week on 15 July 2017?
questions.solution:
An ordinary year has 1 odd day and a leap year has 2 odd days. 

So, the day on the same date for an ordinary year will be 1 day ahead and the day on the same date for a leap year will be 2 days ahead for the next year.

If 21 May 2009 is Thursday, then the day on these dates will be:

21 May 2010 → Friday

21 May 2011 → Saturday

21 May 2012 → Monday

21 May 2013 → Tuesday

21 May 2014 → Wednesday

21 May 2015 → Thursday

21 May 2016 → Saturday

21 May 2017 → Sunday

Number of days between 21 May 2017 to 15 July 2017 = (10 + 30 + 15) = 55

55 when divided by 7, leaves 6 as remainder.

Sunday + 6 = Saturday

Therefore, it will be Saturday on 15 July 2017.

Hence, ‘**Saturday**’ is the correct answer.

Eswar is sitting second to the right of Kalyan. Kalyan is sitting immediate right to Arun, who is to the immediate right of Lokesh. Arun is sitting just opposite to Bavya. Divya is sitting in between Lokesh and Hina. If there are three of them on each side of the long side of the table, and one each on the short side of the table, who is sitting opposite to Mayank?
questions.solution:
As per the given information the sitting arrangements:

1. Arun is sitting just opposite to Bavya.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e8aa6d9618eb9ff72af48a3075f794dc46af3464d952079937ebc38ab35b1d12.png] 

2. Eswar is sitting second to the right of Kalyan and Kalyan is sitting immediate right to Arun, who is to the immediate right of Lokesh.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fe20829ac2812ef7a7d035a176613511f2bf33a694977f009597fd39bfd02004.png] 

3. Divya is sitting in between Lokesh and Hina.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/102c871d4e837c9492ff05bfb498f971ea0b19e56b8a2f1d928e4c67e720f1ee.png] 

4. The remaining person Mayank is sitting between Kalyan and Eswar.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/691e3fd5bc45b4659c0f481cc80202075715a8cac1744650af621467a2c38db5.png] 

Here, Divya is sitting opposite to Mayank.

Hence, the correct answer is** "Divya".**

questions.question:

# : AND :: RWX : %
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/424df617d1c8106d54fab87f17c47b5daf7117798f88dc83ed8f80f848805520.png] 

The logic followed here is:

**Given: **# : AND :: RWX : %

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2b8a2184a4aa904626eb706f640dd4c9b65f8cc58aa38cdb96dcc84c0ff33041.png] 

**Here, it does follow the pattern.**

Option 2) # = LCT, % = XQB

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/55b085b22b101729b7528c616c9b13b7ac8341eefc3ef70b23fefaa2d6d01ba7.png] 

Option 3) # = OZV, % = LCT

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6f1741571848fcd7463a5cc7fa4f2a993300175194416b693ef83ee289654497.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**
